name: mudrpc
description: Mud RPC: gRPC for unstable networks. gRPC's service model over mesh, radio and UDP as sealed packets, without HTTP/2 or a server stack, and a Connect transport so the clients and services protoc-gen-es generates run unchanged.

scripts.postinstall: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, mkdirSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const p = process.env.INIT_CWD + '/.claude'; if (existsSync(p)) { mkdirSync(p + '/skills/mudrpc', { recursive: true }); copyFileSync('SKILL.md', p + '/skills/mudrpc/SKILL.md'); }"
